newsitem.title: USA: Eli Lilly names executives to new posts.
newsitem.headline: Eli Lilly names executives to new posts.

text.p: Eli Lilly and Co said Tuesday it named two executives to the newly created positions of vice president, corporate strategy and policy, and president, U.S. operations.

Mitchell Daniels Jr, president of Lilly's North American pharmaceutical operations, was named vice president, corporate strategy and policy, the company said. He will be responsible for corporate strategy, business development, public policy, communications and government relations.
Daniels also becomes a member of the company's policy committee and will report to Randall Tobias, company chairman.

Alan Clark, vice president, U.S. sales and marketing, was named president, U.S. operations. In this role, Clark will be responsible for the company's pharmaceutical business in the United States and will report to Sidney Taurel, Lilly's president and chief operating officer.

Separately, Lilly said Charles Golden, executive vice president, will assume responsibility for Lilly's PCS Health Systems Inc and Integrated Medical Systems (IMS) subsidiaries. Golden will continue as chief financial officer.

"Realigning responsiility for PCS and IMS will likewise bring additional corporate focus on these important operations, accelerate their progress in building key capabilities and improve their contribution to shareholder value," Tobias said in a statement.
Richard Pilnik, currently area director, Latin America, was named area director, Latin America and Canada, and assumes responsibility for Eli Lilly Canada.
